items.author: chrispirillo.bsky.social
items.context: A disc that nothing on that machine could open becomes a drive letter you can type at a prompt, and that covers a lot of machines people still keep in a closet. Do you keep an old DOS or Windows 95 computer around for games or old files?
items.text: Not a whole machine, but old DOS games are easy to keep. GOG sells many of them DRM-free with DOSBox already set up, so the closet PC isn't required.

items.author: mylittleretro.bsky.social
items.context:
Wo ist Fritz? Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis (1992), one of my all-time favourites and the adventure game closest to my heart. The floppy version, running on my DX4-100 DOS PC with a Roland MT-32. Just listen to that soundtrack. #RetroGaming #DOS #MT32 #LucasArts
video, no description
items.text: That MT-32 soundtrack on real hardware must sound wonderful. Fate of Atlantis was a high point of the LucasArts adventures.

items.author: hbgamer.bsky.social
items.context:
Drawn to Life (Nintendo DS) Finally finished a game I remember from my childhood. Its charming and the drawing aspect is amazing. The gameplay though I feel is just ok as the platforming is fine but the level design is a mixed bag. Bosses are also kind of annoying. That said good game. 7/10
image, no description
items.text: Finishing a game from your childhood is a great feeling, and drawing your own hero was such a fun hook.
